input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligation into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued charges, so we added an exit provision requiring IBM to provide transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return our Content in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and then delete and certify deletion. Our playbook requires data return and migration help on exit; we can accept 90 days of assistance if six months is an issue.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return all Content and other Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and Customer data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
